state_clock: Completed daily observations at day d become usable at UTC d+1; no intraday price from the decision day. Unknown/incomplete history stays unknown. Equity adapters preserve supplied observed sessions.
training: 2024 historical calibration only; all predictive labels end strictly before fit time. Later rolling refits use strictly matured past labels and retain coefficient/scale receipts. All currently available2025/2026history is consumed diagnostic history, not untouchedOOS.

strategy_families.trend: PST EWMAC32/128 using robust35day price-unit volatility and training-only mean-absolute normalization
strategy_families.relative_momentum: Sentinel21day momentum ranking without funding term; top/bottom5 equal weights, local adaptation ablation
strategy_families.carry_momentum: Existing source-pinned Sentinel21day momentum plus inverse5day mean funding ranks, top/bottom5
strategy_families.mean_reversion: PST mr_wings Lfast4/Lslow16: negative EWMAC only if absolute value >=3times prior rolling5000(min3) standard deviation; use common robust35day volatility; source includes current completed observation in trailing std
strategy_families.breakout: PST10day range midpoint forecast smoothed EWM2; use prior closed UTC days
strategy_families.cash: Zero-interest cash benchmark; not an alpha source

source_deviations: Source formulas only; common account execution and crypto UTC calendars differ from source complete systems.
Momentum-only ranking is a preregistered ablation of source carry ranking, not a separately discovered public profitable strategy.
Daily state parameters are a transparent self-developed hypothesis after source review; no claim of an upstream profitable regime classifier.
Trend, breakout and mr_wings use fixed public defaults and common volume eligibility. Sparse reversion may have too few samples; no threshold tuning to create trades.

models.HMM: GaussianHMM3states, diagonal covariance,100iterations,seed17; fit past features, implement forward-only filtering with fixed parameters; no Viterbi or smoothed past labels
models.MLP: MLPClassifier hidden16,tanh,alpha1,Adam,learning_rate0.001,max_iter300,shufflefalse,early_stoppingfalse,seed17; predict one-day benchmark return sign from matured daily labels; compare same-data linear logistic baseline
models.refit: monthly, previous365calendar days, minimum180complete examples; one fixed specification per model, no architecture search

model_overlay: Linear/MLP produce probability of next-day BTC open-to-open positive return. On trend_up,full risk only if probability>=0.55; trend_down full only if<=0.45; otherwise half risk. On range/breakout keep rule risk unchanged. Missing/nonconverged/nonfinite forecasts mean cash. HMM filters3Gaussian states and maps fitted emission means back to raw trend_z/volatility_ratio: volatility_ratio>1 =>breakout, trend_z>=1 =>up, <=-1 =>down, else range; same routing matrix. Never override unknown/liquidity_stress.
mixture: Five fixed unit-gross family targets averaged; net opposing intentions per symbol, keep10largest absolute net weights without re-normalizing after trimming. Multiply by common gross0.8. No strategy-level account-equity stitching.
event_overlay: Only verified official FOMC actual release+5minutes and trailing24hours; reduce gross tohalf. Intraday new availability requires next hourly risk decision, not anticipation of the release. Other news coverage unknown; no claim of general event protection.
